Login flow (no signInWithIdp):
1) Verify Google ID token with Google tokeninfo.
2) Validate issuer/audience/expiry/email_verified.
   - If auth.googleAllowedAudience is configured, aud must match it.
3) Resolve existing Firebase user by google sub (provider mapping).
4) If not found, fallback to email lookup.
   - If google provider already exists on email match -> fail.
   - If google provider missing -> link google.com provider with verified sub.
5) Mint custom token and exchange via signInWit
